cards.card_text: When a sudden death defiles a Nazirite's hair, what must he do on his day of cleansing?
cards.verse_text: If someone suddenly dies in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing—the seventh day.
cards.snippet: …of hair, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing—the seventh day.
